verdict.rationale: Postman ships AI features (Agent Mode, Postbot), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or model-training control. Postman Vault and role permissions are adjacent security features and do not address AI training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
